developmentBacklogAdded.name: Emergency/on-call burden extractor
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Support roles can look excellent on title/pay while hiding emergency support or out-of-hours obligations that materially worsen fit.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Extract on-call, emergency, after-hours and weekend obligations into structured burden fields and penalize before alerting or ranking.

developmentBacklogAdded.name: Freelance client-view recency decay
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Public freelance jobs can remain indexed despite the client not viewing them for days or weeks, wasting proposal effort.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Track lastViewedByClient and sharply decay priority when client activity is stale, while boosting fresh jobs with recent client activity and low proposal counts.
